newsitem.title: USA: US Plains feedlot cattle market quiet - feedlots.
newsitem.headline: US Plains feedlot cattle market quiet - feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle markets early Monday were typically quiet for the start of the week, feedlot sources said.
"There were no trades (early Monday), and no indication there will be trades today," a Texas Panhandle source said.
Packer bids were scattered at $65.00 per cwt and passed by owners pricing cattle at $67.00 to $68.00. The bulk of cattle sales last week were at $67.00 on Wednesday.
Fed cattle this week were expected to sell steady with last week's top amid outlooks for a turnaround in beef prices, several feedlot managers said.
